summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and financial statements. The filing reports gross premiums written of $1.8 billion (up 6.8% YoY), a combined ratio of 86.6%, annualized operating ROAE of 15.2%, and net income of $108.0 million. It also discloses $232.7 million returned to shareholders via share repurchases ($219.4 million at $19.00/share) and dividends. This is a routine earnings report with no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer filing its periodic results. No deal terms are present.
